# Order report
`render(rows, format='csv')` returns a text report. Each row has `id`,
`customer`, and integer `quantity`. CSV remains the default, has the
header `id,customer,quantity`, uses standard CSV quoting, and ends every
row with `\n`. Add `format='jsonl'`: one compact JSON object per row,
with those fields in that order, Unicode preserved, and `\n` after each
object. An empty JSONL report is empty text. Unknown formats raise
`ValueError`. Preserve row order and integer quantities.

import json
import sys
from reports.export import render

if __name__ == '__main__':
    rows = json.load(sys.stdin)
    sys.stdout.write(render(rows, sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'csv'))
